Name: Four Seasons Total Landscaping
Author: JustChaldea
Description:
A mod for user built farm that want zone-aware seasons. Each zone in the farm holds its own season year-round, so crops, weather, fishing, footstep sounds, and indoor lighting all key off whichever zone the player is standing in.

Built for the Four Seasons Landscaping farm pack, but the conventions are documented and any compatible Content Patcher pack can opt in. Map makers, see the Cartographer's Handbook bundled with the mod for the full setup.


[size=5][b]Installation instructions:[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.0 or newer if you don't already have it.[/*]
[*]Drop the FourSeasonsTotalLandscaping folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Install a compatible farm pack (Four Seasons Landscaping is a farm specifically for this ). This mod does nothing on its own; it needs a farm pack to operate on.[/*]
[*]Start a new save and pick your farm at character creation.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Features:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Year-round crop survival[/b] - Crops don't die when the calendar rolls into a new season.[/*]
[*][b]Season-locked planting[/b] - Parsnips only grow in the spring zone, pumpkins only in fall, etc. You can customize the warnings for trying to plant in the wrong place.[/*]
[*][b]Zone-aware visuals[/b] - Wild trees, fruit trees, grass, and bushes all pick their colour from the zone they're standing in, not the calendar season.[/*]
[*][b]Zone-aware weather[/b] - On a rainy day, non-winter zones show rain and the winter zone shows snow, fading between them as the player crosses a boundary. Green rain days keep the green tint over winter snow. The farmhouse picks up the lighting of whichever zone it sits in.[/*]
[*][b]Zone-aware fishing.[/b] Water-type layers in your farm layers direct your cast to the right vanilla fish pool (Mountain, Forest, Beach, etc.), with the player's zone as the active season for fish-condition checks.[/*]
[*][b]Zone-aware footsteps.[/b] It was really weird during testing and I ended up gaslighting myself for a while forgetting there were different footstep sounds for grass and snow...[/*]
[*][b]Pierre's Missing Stocklist on start.[/b] As an option in the config you ship, the player will start with the stocklist that let's Pierre sell each seasons crops. They'll still be more expensive out of season. This will remove the list from QI's room if you enable it.[/*]
[*][b]Multi-season starter gift.[/b] By default the mod will hook up the player with a set of seeds from each season, and you can set those seeds in the config. You can also just plug in 'random' into each string to make it more interesting. ('random' will stay within the boundaries of the season you set it into.)[/*]
[*][b]Bundled map-maker tools.[/b] The Cartographer's Handbook explains the conventions for opting your map in. Helper scripts - Tiled-mode swap (Important for using Vanilla Tilesets), buildable/tillable/plantable overview renderers) ship in the mod's tools folder[/*]
[/list]
